{"basis":"measured","confidence":0.95,"fact_type":"finding","name":"MEASURED 2026-09-28: the served instructions were 29,062 characters against get_instructions' 30,000 default budget; a 1,294-character section pushed them over, so a plain get_instructions would have withheld the whole document, and no gate noticed — now pinned by a test, with 442 characters of headroom left","source":"branch feat/one-search-reaches-every-tracked-design: wc -c getting-started/AGENTS.md on origin/main and on the branch; the test run that failed","statement":"Adding the standing section "Say where you looked before you say it is not there" (req:a-claim-that-the-design-holds-nothing-says-where-it-was-checked) took getting-started/AGENTS.md from 29,062 to 30,356 characters. get_instructions compares the whole body against budget_chars (default 30,000) and, over it, withholds the document whole and returns only the section manifest — by design, since a trimmed instruction set reads like a complete one. So every session's first design call, following the handshake's "CALL get_instructions FIRST", would have received a table of contents. No existing test or gate checked that the default call returns the document: tools/replies_are_bounded.py lists get_instructions as "bounded via `section`", which is true and does not catch this. Caught only because the new test asserted the section's text through a plain call.

REPAIR: the section was cut to 496 characters (document now 29,558; 442 characters of headroom), and crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/one_search_reaches_every_design_a_hub_tracks.rs asserts that get_instructions with no section and the default budget returns the whole document, naming the budget when it does not.

WHAT IS LEFT OPEN: 442 characters is one short paragraph. The next addition to the served instructions has to move something into a skill or a section fetch, or someone has to decide the default budget or the document's shape; the pin makes that a red build rather than a silent change.



CORRECTION 2026-10-06: THE PIN NAMED ABOVE WAS NEVER COMMITTED.
